title: 第745章 结婴神物婴灵果向导的隐藏任务第744章 这里的金丹大佬竟然在当导游
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
茶楼雅室内，林渊随手抛出几杆阵旗，布下一道隔音禁制。
“好了。”
林渊拉过一张紫檀木椅坐下，目光平静地看向苏瑶：
“现在可以说了吧？”
苏瑶看着那熟练的布阵手法，眼底闪过一丝异色。
她在一旁的客座坐下，压低声音道：
“道友可曾听说过，三个月之后即将开启的洛水秘境？”
洛水秘境？
林渊心头微动。
他初来乍到，自然不清楚这秘境的底细，但面上却不动声色地点了点头：
“自然是知道。”
苏瑶见他知晓，神色更加郑重。
“那秘境虽说是元婴强者才有资格进入，但是，里面却生长着一种结婴神物——婴灵果。”
她眼中闪过一抹狂热：
“普通的中品化婴丹，最多只能提升两成结婴几率。
“上品也只能提升三成，肯定不足四成。
“但若能服下一枚婴灵果，便可再提升三成！
“一颗中品化婴丹，再加上一枚婴灵果，那可是足足五成的结婴几率！”
苏瑶身子前倾，目光灼灼地看着林渊：
“只要道友底蕴足够，有了这两样神物，结婴便是板上钉钉之事。”

林渊神色不变，手指轻轻敲击着桌面。
“你也说了，洛水秘境只有元婴强者才有资格进入争夺。”
他嘴角扯出一抹淡笑，看着苏瑶：
“我一个金丹修士，就算知道了这些，又有什么用？”
苏瑶深吸了一口气，将身子往前探了探。
“道友有所不知。
“洛水秘境千年开启一次，漫长岁月下来，也有不少婴灵果树被元婴前辈带出秘境，尝试在外界种植。
“但这些果树，大都被化神甚至炼虚级别的庞大势力牢牢掌握。
“像我们这种无依无靠的金丹散修，根本连见一面的资格都没有。”
林渊没有接话，静静等待着她的下文。
苏瑶咽了口唾沫，声音压得更低了：
“但是，上一个千年，有一名元婴散修前辈，侥幸在秘境中得到了一株婴灵果树的幼苗。
“他没有投靠任何一方大势力，而是将果树悄悄种在了一处隐秘之地。
“他本想借此开枝散叶，培养自己的家族势力。
“可惜天有不测风云，这位前辈后来被仇家追杀，重伤之下提前坐化了。
“他的家族还没来得及建立，便彻底断了传承。”
说到这里，苏瑶的眼中难掩激动之色。
“而他当年种植婴灵果的那处隐秘洞府，前不久被一位金丹道友偶然发现了！”
林渊眉头微挑，眼神瞬间变得锐利起来。
“这等隐秘之事，你怎么会知道？”

这种消息一旦走漏，别说金丹，元婴老怪都会为之疯狂。
苏瑶苦笑一声，坦然迎上林渊审视的目光。
“实不相瞒，那位发现洞府的道友，便是我的同族堂姐。
“那座洞府外围，布有一座四阶极品防御大阵，她一人根本打不开。
“所以她才暗中委托我，若是在坊市见到实力不俗、又身家丰厚的散修金丹，便可拉拢一二。”
content_en:
In the elegant room of the teahouse, Lin Yuan casually threw out a few formation flags and set up a soundproof ban.
"Okay."
Lin Yuan pulled up a rosewood chair and sat down, looking at Su Yao calmly:
"Can we talk now?"
Su Yao looked at the skilled formation techniques, and a strange color flashed in her eyes.
She sat down on the guest seat next to her and lowered her voice:
"Have you ever heard of the secret realm of Luoshui that will be opened in three months?"
Luoshui secret realm?
Lin Yuan's heart moved slightly.
He had just arrived, so naturally he didn't know the details of this secret realm, but he nodded calmly:
"Of course I know."
Seeing that he knew, Su Yao looked more solemn.
"Although only those with strong Nascent Soul are qualified to enter that secret realm, there is a kind of infant-forming divine item growing inside - the Infant Spirit Fruit."
A flash of enthusiasm flashed in her eyes:
"Ordinary mid-grade Infant Transformation Pills can only increase the chance of conceiving a baby by 20% at most.
“The top grade can only be improved by 30%, definitely less than 40%.
“But if you can take one Infant Spirit Fruit, you can increase it by another 30%!
"With a mid-grade Infant Transformation Pill and an Infant Spirit Fruit, that's a full 50% chance of conceiving a baby! "
Su Yao leaned forward and looked at Lin Yuan with burning eyes:
"As long as fellow Taoists have enough foundation and these two divine objects, the birth of a baby is a sure thing. "
Lin Yuan's expression remained unchanged, and he tapped his fingers lightly on the table.
"You also said that only the powerful Nascent Soul in Luoshui Secret Realm are eligible to enter the competition. "
A faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth and looked at Su Yao:
"I am a golden elixir monk, even if I know this, what's the use? "
Su Yao took a deep breath and leaned forward.
"Fellow Taoist, you don't know something.
"The Luoshui secret realm opens once every thousand years. Over the years, many Yingling fruit trees have been taken out of the secret realm by Senior Yuan Ying and tried to be planted in the outside world.
“But most of these fruit trees are firmly controlled by huge forces at the level of transforming gods or even refining voids.
"We, the helpless Jindan cultivators, are not even qualified to meet him."
Lin Yuan did not answer, quietly waiting for her next words.
Su Yao swallowed and lowered her voice:
"However, in the last thousand years, a senior Nascent Soul cultivator was lucky enough to get a sapling of the Infant Spirit Fruit Tree in the secret realm.
"He did not seek refuge with any major force, but quietly planted the fruit trees in a secret place.
“He originally wanted to use this to spread his business and cultivate his family’s power.
"Unfortunately, due to unforeseen circumstances, this senior was later hunted down by his enemies and died early due to serious injuries.
"Before his family could even be established, the inheritance was completely cut off."
Speaking of this, Su Yao couldn't hide the excitement in her eyes.
"And the secret cave where he planted the Yingling Fruit was accidentally discovered by a fellow Jindan Taoist not long ago!"
Lin Yuan raised his eyebrows slightly, and his eyes instantly became sharp.
"How do you know such a secret thing?"
Once this kind of news leaks out, not to mention the golden elixir, all the Yuanying old monsters will go crazy for it.
Su Yao smiled bitterly and met Lin Yuan's scrutinizing gaze calmly.
"To be honest, the fellow Taoist who discovered the cave is my cousin from the same clan.
"There is a fourth-level top-grade defense formation on the outside of that cave, which she cannot open by herself.
"That's why she secretly entrusted me to win over one or two of the powerful and wealthy casual cultivators of Jindan in the market."
